stage.note: Confirmed YC S21 (Active) investment (YC's standard deal is a pre-seed-sized check); no subsequent priced round (seed/Series A) was found in any press, HN, or company materials. Team is small (5) and Artillery has offered an open-source CLI since 2015 plus a paid Cloud/SaaS layer since ~2021-2022, consistent with a lean, possibly still YC-only or largely bootstrapped company. Could not access Crunchbase/PitchBook (blocked) or Google/Bing text results within the time budget, so this is a low-confidence inference, not a confirmed 'no further funding' claim.

note: Founded by solo founder Hassy Veldstra (SRE/open-source developer); company is based in Limerick, Ireland; YC batch page confirms website https://www.artillery.io matches this provider's domain, name 'Artillery', batch Summer 2021 (S21), status Active — the hinted YC company is the same company as this card. Product is open-source (artilleryio on GitHub) with a paid Cloud/Business/Team SaaS layer (per pricing page) layered on top of the free CLI. No acquisition, shutdown, or pivot found. Funding/revenue figures beyond the YC investment could not be confirmed or found as credible estimates in the time available (Crunchbase blocked by Cloudflare; DuckDuckGo/Google/Bing text search did not yield usable results).
